json.text: Okay, so I just got off the phone with my contact. [exhales sharply] They've confirmed the initial reports. This isn't just a local incident anymore; it's escalating quickly. We need to get this out there, like, *now*. I'm thinking a live cross, straight to the scene. [short pause] My notes are all here, just need to organize them into a concise report. We can't afford to miss any details. This is big.
